Access.name: GetQuestionario
Access.Query:
SELECT * FROM CEPE_TW00TBSK SK1 WHERE CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_CODISTI = 88 AND CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_CODAPPL = 'SCHEDCLI'
AND CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_NDGDOSS =
ndgDoss
AND CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_NDGTEMP =
ndgTemp
AND CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE = ( SELECT MAX(CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE) FROM CEPE_TW00TBSK SK2 WHERE CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_CODISTI = 88 AND CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_CODAPPL = 'SCHEDCLI'
AND SK2.CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_NDGDOSS =
ndgDoss
AND SK2.CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_NDGTEMP =
ndgTemp
AND (CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_SEVALID = 'S') AND ((CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DFINVAL = 0) OR (CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DFINVAL > (datepart(year,getdate()) * 10000 + datepart(month,getdate()) * 100 + datepart(day,getdate()) ) ) ) ) AND (CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_SEVALID = 'S') ORDER BY CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_GIOSCHE DESC, CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE DESC

ndgdoss

ndgtemp

AND CEPE_TW00TBQK_X_NDGTEMP =
ndgtemp

datsche AND CEPE_TW00TBQK_N_RELEASE =

Access.name: ElencoDomande
Access.Query: SELECT TIPELEM,NUMELEM,TESTELE,NUMSELE,'N' SELSELE FROM ( SELECT CEPE_TW00TBQC.CEPE_TW00TBQC_X_TIPFINC TIPELEM, CEPE_TW00TBQC.CEPE_TW00TBQC_N_NUMDOMA NUMELEM, CEPE_TW00TBQC.CEPE_TW00TBQC_X_TESTRIG TESTELE, CEPE_TW00TBQC.CEPE_TW00TBQC_N_NUMEROP NUMSELE, CEPE_TW00TBQC.CEPE_TW00TBQC_N_RELEASE VERSIONE FROM CEPE_TW00TBQC WHERE CEPE_TW00TBQC.CEPE_TW00TBQC_N_CODISTI = 88 AND CEPE_TW00TBQC.CEPE_TW00TBQC_X_CODAPPL = 'SCHEDCLI' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_X_RISMULT = 'S' THEN 'M' WHEN CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_X_RISMULT = 'I' THEN 'I' ELSE 'D' END TIPELEM, CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_N_NUMDOMA NUMELEM, CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_X_TESTDOM TESTELE, 000 NUMSELE, CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_N_RELEASE VERSIONE FROM CEPE_TW00TBQD WHERE CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_N_CODISTI = 88 AND CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_X_CODAPPL = 'SCHEDCLI' UNION ALL SELECT 'R' TIPELEM, CEPE_TW00TBQR.CEPE_TW00TBQR_N_NUMDOMA NUMELEM, CEPE_TW00TBQR.CEPE_TW00TBQR_X_TESTDOM TESTELE, CEPE_TW00TBQR.CEPE_TW00TBQR_N_NUMRISP NUMSELE, CEPE_TW00TBQR.CEPE_TW00TBQR_N_RELEASE VERSIONE FROM CEPE_TW00TBQR WHERE CEPE_TW00TBQR.CEPE_TW00TBQR_N_CODISTI = 88 AND CEPE_TW00TBQR.CEPE_TW00TBQR_X_CODAPPL = 'SCHEDCLI' )TAB WHERE VERSIONE = ( SELECT MAX(CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_N_RELEASE) FROM CEPE_TW00TBQD WHERE CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_N_CODISTI = 88 AND CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_X_CODAPPL = 'SCHEDCLI' AND CEPE_TW00TBQD.CEPE_TW00TBQD_N_RELEASE < 100 ) ORDER BY NUMELEM, CASE TIPELEM WHEN 'A' THEN 0 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'I' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'R' THEN 3 WHEN 'P' THEN 4 END, NUMSELE

Access.name: ElencoStorico
Access.Query:
SELECT CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_PROFILO PROFILO, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_FLSKCLI SEBANCA, RIGHT('0000'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(year,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),4) + RIGHT('00'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(month,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),2) + RIGHT('00'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(day,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),2) DATCOMP, RIGHT('00'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(hour,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),2) + RIGHT('00'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(minute,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),2) + RIGHT('00'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(second,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),2) ORACOMP, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_CANVEND CANVEND, RIGHT('00000'+LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_FILOPER))),5) FILIALE, RIGHT('0000'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(year,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),4) + RIGHT('00'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(month,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),2) + RIGHT('00'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(day,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),2) + RIGHT('00'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(hour,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),2) + RIGHT('00'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(minute,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),2) + RIGHT('00'+RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(datepart(second,CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE)))),2) USERKEY, CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_RELEASE VERSIONE, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_CLUSTER CLUSTER, CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DFINVAL DFINVAL, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_SEVALID SEVALID, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_ESIGLIQ ESIGLIQ, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_OBBTEMP_FORZ OBBTEMP_FORZ, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_OBBTEMP_ORIG OBBTEMP_ORIG, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_CLUSTER_ORIG CLUSTER_ORIG, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_ESPFINA, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_OBBINVE, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_OBBTEMP, CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_SITFINA FROM CEPE_TW00TBSK WHERE CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_CODISTI = 88 AND CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_CODAPPL = 'SCHEDCLI'
AND CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_NDGDOSS =
ndgDoss
AND CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_NDGTEMP =
ndgTemp
AND CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_SEVALID = 'S' ORDER BY CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_GIOSCHE DESC,
CEPE_TW00TBSK_X_CANVEND DESC,
CEPE_TW00TBSK_N_DATSCHE DESC
